title: Resolve podcast audio across ephemeral worktrees
motivation: Moves T6 (Data quality) for the podcast source: a backlog of 287 downloaded episodes that could never be transcribed becomes transcribable, and newly downloaded episodes stop being starved by it, so podcast-derived signals stop silently going missing
